name: Persia
overview: Scripture presents Persia as a vast empire extending from India to Ethiopia, governed with structured administration including provincial and municipal oversight. The Persian kings, such as Cyrus and Artaxerxes, played pivotal roles in God's plan for Israel, notably through decrees that enabled the rebuilding of the temple in Jerusalem and the restoration of the people after captivity. These acts demonstrate God's sovereign use of Persian rulers to fulfill prophetic promises and to advance His purposes for His covenant people.
